items.tldr: Schwab's CEO says it blocks dozens of unauthorized AI-agent attempts on client accounts every week; JPMorgan is blocking outside agents too.
items.tldr_zh: Schwab CEO称每周拦截"几十次"未授权AI代理访问客户账户，摩根大通也在拦外部agent
items.take: Banks are blocking the AI that acts for you. If your agent isn't recognized by the world, who exactly are 'you'?
items.take_zh: 银行在拦的是"替你办事的AI"——当你的代理人不被世界承认，"你"到底是谁？

items.tldr: Replit's CEO says OpenAI is now the default model and Anthropic is out, while insisting Replit stays model-agnostic; a source says the partnership still stands.
items.tldr_zh: Replit CEO称OpenAI已成默认模型、Anthropic不再合作，同时坚称"模型无关"；知情人称合作仍在
items.take: For a 'model-agnostic' platform, the default is the stance. Who picked each of your defaults?
items.take_zh: "模型无关"的平台，默认选项就是立场——你的每一个默认设置，是谁替你选的？

items.tldr: Study: people who ghost feel worse about it afterward than the people they ghost realize.
items.tldr_zh: 研究：搞"消失"的人，事后感受比被消失的人以为的糟糕
items.take: Both sides guess the other's feelings, and both guess wrong. Whom does silence actually protect?
items.take_zh: 双方都在猜对方的感受，且都猜错——沉默到底在保护谁？
